notes: The operator’s Rallycross configuration retains the northern and western gravel arc, the long central asphalt hairpin and the southern outer gravel return. The inner karting loops, the asphalt-only outer course and pit lane are excluded. The route is manually digitized on the independently georeferenced GUGiK orthoimage. Surface transitions, temporary barriers, fine corner alignment and historical configuration remain provisional. No diagram coordinates or comparison-course GPS are used. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1255.1 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
